base_2025: experiments/genesis/subst_k4_2025/compose/G_ABPD_2025.rvt (viewer-certified, ledger entry; sha256 6242c3aa..., the registry releases.2025 pin)
emission_gates: each probe passed the FIVE-GATE emission check (experiments/frontdoor2025/emission_check.py): BasicFileInfo Format 2025, pinned 2025 schema aboard, partitions walk clean under 2025 ordinals AND refuse under 2026 ordinals (only 0x0ed9-family framing on disk), validator 0 errors in-context, four-registry coherent + ADocument clean

probes.name: ROOM2025_walls

probes.expected: PASS (walls-alone is the viewer-proven 2026 shape; base certified)
probes.if_fail: the 2025 wall-clone/mutate path differs from 2026 -- bisect against the certified base control (walls are the ONLY delta)

probes.name: ROOM2025_full
probes.built_by: rvt.frontdoor.author (the worked 2500 A room prompt, target_version=2025) inside rvt.frontdoor.release_ctx
probes.contents: 4 walls + 7 generated families (.rfa emitted, family-mode VALID 0 errors, provenance clean) loaded four-registry + 7 placed instances
